verdict.rationale: Automating background tasks is a fair question for a desktop OS. The only relevant evidence is a doc entry on starting an application at login, a basic primitive for launching programs automatically, not a documented automation or agent framework. Missing for 10: scheduled or triggered background jobs (e.g. timers/cron) in the evidence, AI or agent-driven autonomous automations, in-depth docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
